css/codex-scene.css: Codex scene styles: stage, vertical category tabs, side panel (list, dossier, customizer, lore ticker), control deck, clean view
css/controls.css: Hotbar and skill book in the bottom tray, side-panel world map, Market and Settings overlays (sized by --s)
css/dialog.css: Dialogue box, quest tracker/log, service menu and panel overlays; --s = integer canvas scale set by main.js fitCanvas
css/gamepad.css: Gamepad corner badge, toast and guide modal styles (js/gamepad.js)
css/guild.css: Guild service/contract overlay, independent tracker and ceremony styles
css/hud.css: HD interface styles using the Aseprite frames in assets/ui/ (hero card, party slots, meters, key chips)
css/premium.css: Premium modal, checkout, shop cards and upper-left buff timer styles
css/style.css: Global page layout, pixelated canvas, side panel, bottom bar / adventure log tray
css/summon.css: Summon panel styles (choices, switches, stock steppers) on top of css/premium.css
css/title.css: Title screen, options, Chronicles reader and credits; defines --gold/--sky/--ink colour variables
data/art_manifest.json: Every generated image (banners, title/portal backgrounds, vistas, portraits, relics): kind, EN/FIL caption and where the game uses it; paired with tools/art/scenes/index.js
data/codex_entries.json: Codex scene data: Earthbound dossiers for the hero classes (EN/FIL) and the falcon/angel companion records
data/errand.json: Summon errand tuning (pack slots, stack per slot, trip time, what it may buy) and EN/FIL wording
data/loading_tips.json: Portal loading screen wording and EN/FIL lore tips (js/loading.js)
data/npc_conversations.json: NPC ambient chatter: solo lines per NPC and two-NPC exchanges, each line with en/fil text (fetched by npc/npcs.js)
data/party.json: Recruitment talk (offer / progress / join) for the five playable NPCs and the party HUD/toast wording, EN/FIL
data/prologue.json: Prologue text by shot id (cards, typed lines with speakers, EN/FIL) and the status panel lines; read by js/prologue.js
data/tilemaps.json: Saved terrain tile map layouts per theme, read by the tile map system and tools/tilemap/preview.mjs
index.html: Page shell: canvas #gameCanvas inside #stage/#viewport, title/codex-scene/dialog overlays, bottom bar, save file input, Google Fonts; loads js/main.js as a module
js/actintro.js: Act intro cinematic (ActIntro): an HD overlay that rebuilds the Act's layered set (assets/cinema/act-N) with the cinema engine and the camera/lights/particles of js/cinema/actShots.js, then sets the Act number, title and EN/FIL caption (data/art_manifest.json) in HD type; skippable; startStory for story cards
js/actionpanel.js: Hotbar on the bottom tray (J/K/L skill slots with drag-and-drop arranging and the skill book (P), Space/E, quick slots 1–4, Market B and Full Screen F) and the right panel's option buttons
js/actreader.js: "Read more" Act reader: full text of finished Acts from LORE.md with their banners
js/audio.js: Procedural Web Audio engine (exported Sound): master/music/SFX buses with compressor and reverb, synth instruments, a lookahead sequencer that crossfades the tracks in js/music.js by place/night/boss (setScene), fanfares (playJingle) and 30+ play* SFX that fade by distance and mute off screen
js/autoadventure.js: Timed autonomous quest navigation, objective combat, scouting and physical travel routes with private pathfinding
js/avatar/avatar.js: Modular pixel-art Avatar renderer: layered parts (cape, hair, body, arms, held item), five views (three-quarter views turned from front/back) for 8 directions, facial expressions per animation (blink, determined, angry, hurt), cached frames; Pix buffer and shade helpers; optional Aseprite sheet (sheetKey) like CreatureSprite
js/avatar/beasts.js: Act monster sprites (sporeling, drake, crab, serpent, brute, imp, specter, treant, …) with idle/walk/attack frames
js/avatar/creature.js: Non-human sprite base (CreatureSprite; uses Aseprite sheet frames when loaded, incl. extra anims and larger canvases) plus slime, wolf and falcon sprites and SheetBossSprite (a boss drawn from its Aseprite sheet, code sprite ×2 as fallback); facingFrom direction helper
js/avatar/facing.js: Eight-direction facing shared by every actor: five drawn views (down, dside, side, uside, up; right-facing mirrored), facing8(dx, dy) with hysteresis, applyFacing, drawView
js/avatar/jobmarks.js: Class signature details from the splash art (look `job`): Knight crest and gold trim, Archer hooded mantle and falcon feather, Priest stole and circlet, Mage starry cloak and orbiting star, Fighter open gi, black belt and headband tails; drawn in layers by renderPix
js/avatar/options.js: Character Creator choices and colours, NPC-only parts, config normalisation and random look/name
js/avatar/sheets.js: Aseprite sprite sheets: loads assets/sprites/manifest.json ({ sheets, lazy }) and slices each sheet into per-tag frames ("<dir>-<anim>") that override the code-drawn frames; monster sheets load on first use; sheetCount for frame counts
js/avatar/tilestyle.js: Terrain tile-set look shared by every sprite: tileShade (hue-shifted ramps), tileGrade, inkHex outlines and tileStyle(pix) (upper-left light, grain, contact shade, hue-shifted 1 px outline); pure, used by the game and the Node painters
js/background.js: Background image helpers for assets/bg/: loadImage and cover-fit drawCover
js/behavior.js: Idle behaviors for every living creature (hero, monsters, bosses, NPCs, guild staff, mercenaries, angels, familiars): random pools, poses and pixel emotes
js/bestiary.js: Monster and boss definitions per Act (stats, sprite, medium, debuffs, en/fil names, boss move style and attacks), night kinds and blights
js/camera.js: Camera following the player, clamped to world bounds; isVisible() for frustum culling
js/charpanel.js: Character panel (C): Ragnarok-style stat builder (STR/AGI/VIT/INT/DEX/LUK) with the auto stat path, class skill trees, and the Paths tab (style meter, three path trees, T/Y/U slots)
js/chatlog.js: Bottom adventure log tray: NPC lines, hits taken, loot, gear changes (newest first)
js/cinema/actShots.js: ACT_SHOTS: per-Act camera move, horizon, focus rack, grade, lights, rays, fog, particles and title accent for the Act intros; storyShot(color) for story cards
js/cinema/engine.js: HD cinema engine (Cinema): layered pixel-art sets from assets/cinema/ drawn at screen resolution with a keyframed parallax camera, depth of field, light maps, live lights, god rays, fog, particles, bloom, grade, vignette, grain, letterbox, flash/shake/fade; loadSet, span/ease helpers, CINEMA_WIDTH per Quality
js/cinema/fx.js: Cinema HD effects in native coordinates: glow, rune circle, beam, eclipse, lightning bolt, sky rift, glowing crack, warp tunnel, birds, mana crystal, status panel
js/cinema/particles.js: Cinema particles: depth-aware ambient fields (embers, sparks, motes, dust, spores, stars, snow, blizzard, rain, ash, petals, miasma) and one-shot bursts, drawn as soft bokeh out of focus
js/cinema/prologueShots.js: The nine prologue shots (buildShots(cast)): backdrop set, camera path, focus, grade, lights, fog, particles and hooks for the live parts (eclipse, Satan rising, wolf, King and summoner, rift, ritual, waking)
js/classes/archer.js: Elven Archer class: quiver capacity, timed reload, falcon strike
js/classes/fighter.js: Fighter (Brawler) class: ki spheres, lock-on, homing flying dropkick
js/classes/job.js: Job look after the Job Awakening: keeps the creator body, swaps outfit and weapon per class
js/classes/knight.js: Knight (Aegis Lancer) class: stats and attack/skill handlers
js/classes/mage.js: Mage (Arcane Sage) class: meteor and thunderstorm skills
js/classes/novice.js: Novice starting class (dagger + buckler) before the Lv 10 Job Awakening
js/classes/priest.js: Priest class: smart heal and Guardian Angel summons
js/codex.js: Codex data: progress (kills, NPCs met, saved), entries per tab and the detail panels; shown by js/scenes/codexScene.js
js/continent.js: Continent world map art and data: Aethelgard, its frontiers and the Dark Continent with roads, biomes, side-quest badges and the Book II isle
js/daynight.js: Day/night cycle (6-minute day): phases, night tint and night monster behaviour
js/devtools.js: Developer tools panel (?dev, F9): cheats (level, gold, items, god mode, travel, spawns), save inspection/import/export, live hero stats
js/dialog.js: HTML dialogue box with speaker portrait, quest tracker HUD and quest log overlays
js/dialogue.js: Story dialogue for Acts II–VI per NPC and quest step (en/fil); getDialogue(id, ctx), npcName
js/elements.js: Race, element, size and type tables with damage multipliers and variant prefixes (Ragnarok style), en/fil names
js/enemy.js: Enemy manager: monster spawning (hub, platforms, frontiers, elites, night, ambushes, bosses), AI state machines, telegraphed attacks, boss move styles (drift/blink, charge, chained) and skills (tear rain, wail cone, bone lances, chain sweep/grab, shockwave rings) with Aseprite effects, tiers/elements, death and drops
js/errand.js: Summon errands: the familiar/Falcon/Guardian Angel carries a 9-slot pack to market from the field (sell non-quest items, buy potions and herbs), is out of combat until back; ErrandPack order, dispatch, updateErrand, save/load
js/fx.js: Game feel: screen shake, hit-stop, shockwave rings, sparks, blood, water splashes (droplets + ripples), damage numbers, flashes, vignette
js/fxsprites.js: Effect sprites from Aseprite (assets/sprites/fx/<name>, "down-play" tag): drawFx with rotation, size, anchor, alpha and cached tints; false when not loaded so callers keep their code-drawn effect
js/gamepad.js: Gamepad support (DS4 / DualSense / Joy-Con / Xbox): button mapping to game keys, connect badge, toast and guide modal
js/guild.js: Independent guild membership, ability assessment, paid resets, escalating plate replacements, 90 ranked contracts and atomic rewards
js/guildceremony.js: Four-scene animated membership assessment, oath and plate-award cinematic
js/guilddata.js: Guild ranks, level thresholds, roles, pillar memberships, hall placement and EN/FIL text
js/guildfield.js: Source-aware gathering, NPC supplies, guild MVP encounters and saved caravan routes with attacker waves, armour and health gauges
js/guildpanel.js: Staff services, guild contracts and independent progress tracker with localized rewards and confirmation controls
js/hudbar.js: Hero card over the top-right of the game screen (name and role of the member on the field, level, HP/stamina/EXP, status icons) plus the side panel's field state and Quest/Pause buttons
js/i18n.js: UI strings in English and Filipino (STRINGS.en / STRINGS.fil), language stored in localStorage; t(key), getLang/setLang/toggleLang/onLangChange
js/inventory.js: Inventory panel (I): hero look, worn equipment, stats, tabbed bag, item details and actions (equip, upgrade, refine, sockets)
js/items/bag.js: Bag and equipment: stacking, equip/unequip, set bonuses, upgrades and refines, serialisation
js/items/cooking.js: Fishing and cooking data: fish per place, food items, 15 dishes (5 per STR/DEX/INT) with stat and skill buffs, cook/eat
js/items/crafting.js: Safe-zone crafting: base item per class/path/slot, craft checks, crafting pieces, auto-craft, recommended path, material transmutes
js/items/craftsets.js: Crafted gear data: STR/DEX/INT paths, Lv 10/25/50/75/100 tiers, ores/cores/essences, crafted sets with stat and skill boosts, monster material drops, recipes, ore veins per platform
js/items/durability.js: Equipment durability: wear on use, broken state, repair cost
js/items/economy.js: Buy and sell prices: sell rates per item type, shop stock and markups, market saturation (Market) and sell()
js/items/forge.js: Emberhold Forge (Brakka): set recipes, forging pieces, tempering
js/items/icons.js: 16×16 pixel item icons, cached per kind and colour (canvas and data URL)
js/items/itemdb.js: Item database (Ragnarok/Diablo style): slots, rarity, sets, grades, cards, affixes, drop rolls, describe/statText
js/items/refineglow.js: Refinement tier palettes, thicker sprite outlines, orbit rings and sparkling equipment auras through +15
js/juice.js: Shared combat animation helpers for every fighter: rest/hit/attack/windup/breath/spawn poses, swing arcs
js/keybinds.js: Rebindable keyboard controls (vanguard_keys): next party member, party member 1–6, full screen; matches / actionOf / bindFrom / label
js/loading.js: Portal loading screen: rotating ring, ENTERING <place>, lore tip (data/loading_tips.json), progress bar; runs the travel work behind it
js/loot.js: Loot drops: gold and items from slain monsters, ground items, magnetic pickup into the bag; blocked drops slide to the nearest walkable tile (findNearestWalkableSpot)
js/lore.js: Loads LORE.md / LORE_FIL.md, parses ## Acts into chapters, act banners, auto-scrolling lore panel
js/main.js: Entry module and coordinator: canvas fit, scene routing (title → codex scene (creator) → prologue → game), managers, menus/shops, platform travel, save/load/export/import, Job Awakening, update + render game loop
js/market.js: Market (B): buy and sell with a quantity slider per row (prices from items/economy.js via ctx) inside a sanctuary; outside one the same overlay builds and sends a summon errand (errand.js)
js/mercenary/axe.js: Axe mercenary: stats, Whirlwind, War Cry, Bloodlust
js/mercenary/crossbow.js: Crossbow mercenary: ranged stats and skills
js/mercenary/greatsword.js: Greatsword mercenary: heavy melee stats and skills
js/mercenary/wand.js: Wand mercenary: caster stats and skills
js/mercenaryManager.js: Hireable mercenaries: contracts and fees, following, AI combat, daze and recovery, drawing
js/monsterTiers.js: Monster tiers (Normal, Champion, Elite, MVP) and modifiers: rolling, applying, damage multipliers, names, life bars (lives per level and tier)
js/music.js: Music score as data: note/chord helpers, bass/arp/pad pattern styles, compileTrack, TRACKS (title, hub, night, canopy, coast, frost, ash, siege, maw, boss, finale), AREA_TRACK (platform id → track) and JINGLES
js/npc/npcs.js: NPCs in the world: spawning per place, wandering, ambient chatter (npc_conversations.json), sparring, talking
js/npc/roster.js: Lore characters from LORE.md: Avatar looks, places, mentor per class, summoner (Aurelia/Kenneth)
js/padnav.js: Panel navigation with arrows / D-pad + Enter: moves a highlight between buttons of mouse-first HTML panels
js/party.js: Party of the hero + recruited playable NPCs (up to 6): who is on the field, per-member HP, switching (player.active kit), next member steps in on a fall, sanctuary recovery, recruitment talk and trial progress (PlayableQuestBook), Eirene's consoles; text from data/party.json
js/partyhud.js: Party list under the hero card (switch key, head, name, HP; the member on the field lit) and the hero card's portrait head, drawn from each member's Avatar portrait
js/playables.js: Playable NPC recruits: PLAYABLES (region, role, skills, trial requirements), makePlayableKit (combat kit per recruit), PlayableQuestBook (trial state)
js/player.js: Player entity: stats, stamina/sprint/dodge roll, damage and debuffs, EXP/levels, skill learning, movement, attack pose, drawing
js/premium.js: Premium peso wallet, demo payments, reversible Platinum exchanges, purchases, permanent skills, timed buffs and attack transmute effects
js/premiumshop.js: Bilingual premium store, demo checkout, protected refinement controls and upper-left premium status HUD
js/projectiles.js: Player/mercenary projectiles and skill effects (meteor, thunder, arrows, ki spheres, dropkick) and their hit detection
js/prologue.js: Act I prologue (PrologueScene): nine HD cinematic shots (js/cinema/prologueShots.js) with typed EN/FIL subtitles from data/prologue.json; Enter advances, Esc skips
js/quest.js: Main quest (Book I, Acts II–XV): steps with act, place, characters, objectives; QuestManager progress, side-quest gate, Book titles; mentor per class; save migration (v1/v2 → v3)
js/regression.js: Regression (New Game+): difficulties Easy→Mythical (+20% monster HP/damage each), saved record of cleared difficulties and learned jobs, end-of-Book-I modal (Continue / save+download / Regress)
js/saveSecurity.js: Save format .vof: checksum/HMAC-style signing, XOR obfuscation, sanity audit of gold/stats/items/level, legacy .json migration; exposed as window.SaveSecurity
js/scenes/codexScene.js: Codex scene: one entity viewer for the Character Creator, the Job Awakening and the Codex (N); Heroes/Enemies/Summons/NPCs/Items tabs, turntable, stances, dossier, lore ticker, control deck
js/services.js: NPC service menu: short choice list (mouse, 1–9, arrows + Enter) shown after talking to a service NPC
js/settings.js: Settings shared by the title Options and the in-game Settings panel (O): SETTINGS list (volumes, FPS limit, brightness, shadows, glow, quality…), load/normalize/save vanguard_config, stepSetting, GFX drawing flags, glowAt cached additive halo, toggleFullscreen, SettingsPanel overlay
js/sidequest.js: Book I side quests: 5–10 seeded per Act (hunt, trophy, elite, scout, cull, champion, sky) that gate the main quest; en/fil text, rewards, scouting-site cairns
js/skillpaths.js: Might (STR) / Finesse (DEX) / Arcana (INT) skill paths: passive and active nodes, play-style affinity (noteStyle/styleOf), resonance, T/Y/U skill slots (assignSlot, castActive, tickActives) for the hotbar
js/skills.js: Stat builder rules and skill trees per class (Ragnarok style): stat costs/caps, skill definitions and bonuses, learn rules (level, style, own summon), resonance, auto stat path (autoAllocate), en/fil text
js/skillslots.js: Hotbar skill slots J/K/L: which ability sits in each slot (drag and drop), logical() maps a pressed key to its slot's ability for the controller and main.js, saved as skillKeys; ActionPanel.addSlotGroup adds more slot groups (e.g. path actives)
js/stage.js: Hub map of the Aethelgard plains (Acts I–VI): Barracks, Citadel, 4 Warp Gateways, safe zones; draws the world layers (draw, drawShadows, drawPropsBack/Front, drawSurface, drawOverlay); same interface as world/platform.js
js/status.js: Abnormal statuses (Seven Anomaly Blights: bleed, silence, poison, shock, burn, freeze, blind): effects, resist chance, ticking
js/summonpanel.js: Summon panel (F6 · Options → Summon): auto attack mode/range and premium Auto Defend/Loot/Sell/Buy switches and rules
js/summons/angel.js: Priest's Guardian Angel companion: lifespan, hover/attack/taunt AI, drawing
js/summons/automation.js: Z-controlled pet loot pathfinding, defensive targeting, automatic falcon strikes and guardian angel replacement
js/summons/errands.js: Premium Auto Sell / Auto Buy: the summon sells plain spare gear and restocks potions every 10 s within a gold budget
js/summons/falcon.js: Archer's falcon companion: dive attacks, taunts, afterimages
js/summons/familiar.js: Familiars for heroes with no summon (Novice slime, Knight hound, Mage owl, Fighter fox): learned in the skill tree, follow and fight on their own; syncFamiliar, familiarDamage
js/summons/premiumecho.js: Permanent playable NPC echo companion using signature attacks and premium collection skills
js/summons/summoncfg.js: Summon settings saved in player.premium.summon: attack mode, range, sell rules, potion stock, spend share, errand interval; clamped on load
js/title.js: Title screen scene: menu, options (music/sfx/blood/weather/language), Chronicles, credits, save slot info; canvas draws embers and sword glow
js/ui.js: In-canvas UI: terrain minimap with objective/compass/place name (drawn in the right panel's World Map box), overhead cooldown bar, and the framed pause, Apothecary shop, Mercenary Guild and game over panels (EN/FIL via t())
js/ui/loreTicker.js: Auto-scrolling story text box (wheel/drag to scroll by hand) for the Codex scene
js/ui/turntablePedestal.js: 2.5D stone turntable for the Codex scene: rune ring, 8-way heading pip, drag/keys with inertia; snaps headings to front/side/back art
js/uiframe.js: Shared look for in-canvas panels: drawFrame (slate panel, gold double border, corner studs, title ribbon, open animation), drawBorder, drawBackdrop, openEase, keyChip
js/workshop.js: Workshop menu (G in a safe zone): craft sets, auto-craft toggle, cooking, transmutes; save/load of craft, meal and market
js/world/ambient.js: Per-platform ambience particles and sky colour (spores, storm, blizzard, ash, …)
js/world/areas.js: Book I map registry: hub area (kinds, elites, sites, Badlands trail), areaDef/areaName/areaLevels over hub, platforms and frontiers, actAreas(act) for side quests
js/world/barracks.js: Barracks Sanctuary safe zone on the hub map: drawing and bounds
js/world/boat.js: Crewed sailing ship in the Cerulean Abyss: faces E/W/N/S as it sails, boarding, deck posts for companions, landing at any shore, save state, return to the pier; and the sea monolith
js/world/castle.js: Imperial Citadel on the hub map: drawing and solid hitboxes
js/world/edges.js: Barrier band along every Act platform / frontier map edge: solid tiles, themed boulders + trees on land, rolling haze (fog, smoke, poison gas…) over water
js/world/fishing.js: Fishing at liquid tiles: cast, bite, hook with E, bobber/line drawing and prompt
js/world/footfall.js: Footsteps and splashes: strides on the wet shore splash (hero: wet step sound), steps in tall flora brush, shots ending over water splash
js/world/frontiers.js: Four frontier maps (Greyhorn Badlands, Gloomwater Fens, Stormcrown Highlands, Sunscorch Dunes): Acts, levels, themes, monsters, elites, sites, terrain and landmarks, en/fil text
js/world/grassland.js: Layer 1 ground details on the tile map: baked sand/wet-sand shoreline beside water, turf blades swaying in the wind, isFloraAt for footstep cues
js/world/guildhall.js: Aseprite guild hall/NPC loading, safe-zone unlock, physical footprints and world drawing
js/world/layers.js: World render layer order (0 ocean … 7 screen), sun vector and shadow colour, view/tile-span helpers, pixel ellipse
js/world/layouts.js: Seeded terrain grids for terrain.js (islands, coast, lakes, river, atoll, archipelago) with routed roads (turn- and shore-penalised search, main roads 2 wide) · makeLayout, addPaths, LAYOUT_KINDS
js/world/mining.js: Ore veins on every platform (tier ore, plus minerals on Ashfall and the Citadel; rock salt): picks per vein, ore drops
js/world/nav.js: Ground movement for monsters, mercenaries and walking pets: obstacle grid, flow field toward the hero, steering around obstacles, confinement to bounds
js/world/ocean.js: Water of a map (real-water themes only): baked depth gradient #00b4d8→#03045e + bedrock, moving currents, A·sin(ωt) foam crests and glints, isWaterAt/isShoreAt
js/world/platform.js: Platform or frontier map for one Act: tilemap, ambience, return gateway, frontier trail, safe zones; same interface as Stage
js/world/platforms.js: Campaign platform definitions for Acts VII–XV (Aethelgard + the Dark Continent: strand, ossuary, siege, chainspire, maw): places, 5 monsters + 4 elites, sites, frontier trails, roads/rifts, bosses, quest items, seal stones, en/fil text · DARK_CONTINENT
js/world/portal.js: Celestial Warp Gateways and the Badlands trail: drawing and collision; calls main.js's handler to travel or report sealed
js/world/props.js: Trees, stones and shoreline boulders as Y-sorted props: cached sprites, root-only collision boxes (lower third), contact shadows along the sun, map snapshots
js/world/terrain.js: Terrain tile maps from the Aseprite tile sets (assets/sprites/tiles/<theme>): dual-grid autotiling (16 corner tiles) for ground/cliffs/shore and paths, baked ground + decor, animated liquid and foam; TILESHEET layout shared with the painter
js/world/tilemap.js: Tile map generation and rendering from the tileset, foot hitbox collision, decorations
js/world/tileset.js: Procedural 16×16 pixel-art tile atlas, themes, seeded RNG (mulberry32), tree/rock/bush drawing
js/world/weather.js: Hub weather cycle (clear, rain, storm, fog) with pixel-art clouds and shadows
js/world/zonesprites.js: Safe-zone art from Aseprite (zone/barracks, zone/castle, zone/<map id> camps and Emberhold): ZONE_ART placement + solid footprints, campLayout shared with the painter, drawZoneArt, zoneSolids, pushOutOf
js/worldmap.js: World map (M): zoomable/pannable region view (grid, sites, elites, route, side panel) and continent view; Tab, L, zoom and pan keys, mouse wheel
scripts/gamebrowser.mjs: Headless-Chromium game driver shared by playtest, autoplay, visual-review and the vof-game MCP server: static server, flows, key scripts, seeded Math.random, state summary via window.__vof, setupHero, and the autoplay bot (BFS pathing over the tile grid)
scripts/headless.mjs: Headless loader: stubs document/window/localStorage/canvas so Node can import the game's modules (used by the balance, content and sprite tools); seedRandom for repeatable runs
scripts/test-auto-adventure-browser.mjs: Browser integration checks for autonomous NPC talks, manual override, gateway travel, scouting, awakening, expiry, boss loot and quest delivery
scripts/test-auto-adventure.mjs: Verify auto-adventure obstacle clearance, objective targeting, locked routes, scouting and completion
scripts/test-auto-attack.mjs: Regression checks for auto-attack real-time allowance, soulstones and coin denominations
scripts/test-auto-smoothness-browser.mjs: Live browser verification of autonomous path smoothness and arrival
scripts/test-auto-smoothness.mjs: Headless regression checks for continuous movement, target priority and summon coordination
scripts/test-behavior.mjs: Headless test: idle behavior pools/poses and the Act V guild-registration quest gate
scripts/test-coin-drops.mjs: Verify increasing coin rewards, exact denomination totals, pickup precision and Aseprite source/export coverage
scripts/test-difficulty.mjs: Headless regression check: every monster and boss scales across six difficulties; mercenary contract cap, increasing fees, KO occupancy and expiration
scripts/test-errands.mjs: Headless test: premium Auto Sell / Auto Buy purchase, save, toggle, kept valuables and gold budget
scripts/test-guild-browser.mjs: Browser checks of real staff interactions, membership ceremony, guild services, rewards, automatic allocation, persistence and Filipino UI
scripts/test-guild-contracts.mjs: Verify distinct hunt tiers, source-aware delivery, NPC supplies and caravan guiding, waves, damage, failure and persistence
scripts/test-guild.mjs: Verify unlock, membership/ranks, fees, independent refunds, discounts, replacements, atomic rewards, allocation and saves
scripts/test-loot-drop.mjs: Headless test: drops thrown into walls, water, cliffs and unreachable pockets on the hub and every platform land on walkable ground (loot.js findNearestWalkableSpot)
scripts/test-modal-hud-browser.mjs: Browser regression check: field HUD overlays hide for map, inventory, character, quests, settings and premium panels and restore after closing
scripts/test-premium-browser.mjs: Live premium checkout, peso conversion, HUD, recruitment and persistence checks
scripts/test-premium.mjs: Headless premium transaction, save validation, skill and guaranteed +15 refinement tests
scripts/test-refine-glow-browser.mjs: Browser checks for refinement glows and Escape/Backspace modal controls
scripts/test-sidebar-browser.mjs: Browser check: grouped Act and Adventure Log tab, auto-rotating Premium Shop advertisement, field animation, keyboard tabs and reduced motion
scripts/test-skill-buttons-browser.mjs: Browser check: prominent hero skill buttons, click animation, cooldown progress and countdown, ready glow, reduced motion and tray bounds
scripts/test-skill-points.mjs: Regression checks for independent skill and path point pools and legacy save migration
scripts/test-summon-auto-browser.mjs: Browser checks of Z pet pickups with a stationary owner, toggle pause/resume, automatic falcon strikes and guardian summoning
scripts/test-summon-auto.mjs: Verify summon looting, defensive priority, timer and boarding guards, callbacks, bag limits and class summon cooldowns
scripts/test-terrain-browser.mjs: Browser validation of all animated Aseprite tilesets, campaign/frontier rendering, unchanged collision grids and terrain resource teardown
tools/art/lib/darkBosses.js: Hand-painted figures of the Dark Continent bosses (dolora, morgrave, vorgath) shared by the Act banners and portraits
tools/art/lib/kit.js: Painting kit for scenes: skies, eclipse/moon/sun, clouds, ridges, water/lava, castles, trees, rocks, crystals, rune circles, beams, rays, sparks, character staging (stand, rimLight) and discipline colours
tools/art/lib/px.js: Px pixel buffer (shapes, gradients, glow, blit, silhouette, vignette, quantize, toCanvas) plus colour, noise, fbm, Bayer dither and banded ramp helpers; layered mode (beginLayers/layer/layerCanvases) for cinema sets
tools/art/lib/sprites.js: Game sprites for the art tools: NPC, hero, monster, boss and item-icon frames from the real Avatar/creature/icon code, plus the Lantern Knight look
tools/art/render.mjs: Renders the procedural art to PNG in headless Chromium: node tools/art/render.mjs [keys…] [--list] [--preview]; PNG8 when ≤256 colours; cine-* keys write layered sets to assets/cinema/ + manifest.json
tools/art/scenes/act01.js: Art painter — Act I — The Sundered Dominion of Aethelgard
tools/art/scenes/act02.js: Art painter — Act II — The Celestial Rift & The Earthbound Summoning
tools/art/scenes/act03.js: Art painter — Act III — The Five Disciplines & Earthbound Profiles
tools/art/scenes/act04.js: Art painter — Act IV — The Novice's Path & The Royal Job Awakening
tools/art/scenes/act05.js: Art painter — Act V — The Dual Equipment Matrix & Strategic Warfare
tools/art/scenes/act06.js: Art painter — Act VI — The Royal Covenant & The Vanguard Campaign
tools/art/scenes/act07.js: Art painter — Act VII — The Corrupted Sylvan Frontier & The Elven Sanctuary
tools/art/scenes/act08.js: Art painter — Act VIII — The Cerulean Abyss & The Sunken Monoliths
tools/art/scenes/act09.js: Art painter — Act IX — The Frostfang Precipice & The Shivering Siege
tools/art/scenes/act10.js: Art painter — Act X — The Ashfall Wastelands & The Hellforge
tools/art/scenes/actChainspire.js: Art painter — Act XIV — The Chainspire Descent (chain spire over the abyss, Vorgath)
tools/art/scenes/actMaw.js: Art painter — Act XV — The Heart of the Abyss & The Sovereign Dawn
tools/art/scenes/actOssuary.js: Art painter — Act XII — The Ossuary Fields (bone field, the Lantern Knight's cairn, Morgrave)
tools/art/scenes/actSiege.js: Art painter — Act XIII — The Siege of the Obsidian Citadel & The Broken Gates
tools/art/scenes/actStrand.js: Art painter — Act XI — The Lamenting Strand (Dawnstar wreck, tear pools, Dolora over the water)
tools/art/scenes/heralds.js: Art painter — Heralds — The Inverted Star
tools/art/scenes/index.js: Scene registry: key → output path, native size, upscale and painter module; paintScene(key)
tools/art/scenes/ledger.js: Art painter — Ledger — The Rules of the Summoned
tools/art/scenes/portal.js: Art painter — Portal — The Pentagram Gate
tools/art/scenes/portraits.js: Art painter — Portrait cards — one per lore character, drawn with the character's in-game sprite on a backdrop
tools/art/scenes/proBlights.js: Prologue cinema set painter (layered, assets/cinema/pro-*) — The Seven Blights (blood moon, burning village, dead forest)
tools/art/scenes/proEarth.js: Prologue cinema set painter (layered, assets/cinema/pro-*) — Earth, 2026 (rainy city street under the eclipse)
tools/art/scenes/proEclipse.js: Prologue cinema set painter (layered, assets/cinema/pro-*) — The Eclipse of the Abyss (dusk land, Satan as a layer)
tools/art/scenes/proGolden.js: Prologue cinema set painter (layered, assets/cinema/pro-*) — The Golden Age (golden-hour plains, Citadel, Celestial Gateways)
tools/art/scenes/proOmen.js: Prologue cinema set painter (layered, assets/cinema/pro-*) — A Distant Omen (crater, four pillars)
tools/art/scenes/proRitual.js: Prologue cinema set painter (layered, assets/cinema/pro-*) — The Ritual beneath the Citadel (summoning vault, pedestal)
tools/art/scenes/proSanctuary.js: Prologue cinema set painter (layered, assets/cinema/pro-*) — Waking in the Barracks Sanctuary (courtyard, cot)
tools/art/scenes/proThrone.js: Prologue cinema set painter (layered, assets/cinema/pro-*) — The King and the Heir (throne hall, stained glass)
tools/art/scenes/prophecy.js: Art painter — Prophecy — The Pentagram Seal
tools/art/scenes/relics.js: Art painter — Relics and sigils — 32×32 item art for story objects that have no in-game icon yet: the four
tools/art/scenes/title.js: Art painter — Title — The Lantern Knight's Sword
tools/art/scenes/vistaBarracks.js: Art painter — Vista — The Barracks Sanctuary by day
tools/art/scenes/vistaDawn.js: Art painter — Vista — The Sovereign Dawn
tools/art/scenes/vistaEarth.js: Art painter — Vista — Earth, 2026: the day of the eclipse
tools/art/scenes/vistaElven.js: Art painter — Vista — The Elven Sanctuary restored
tools/art/scenes/vistaEmberhold.js: Art painter — Vista — The Emberhold Forge
tools/art/scenes/vistaHarbor.js: Art painter — Vista — Crossing to the Dark Continent
tools/art/scenes/vistaLantern.js: Art painter — Vista — The Lantern Knight, three centuries ago
tools/art/scenes/worldMap.js: Art painter — Vista — Map of the two continents
tools/art/studio.html: Art studio page: paints every scene (or ?only=key) for review; exposes renderScene/sceneList to render.mjs
tools/aseprite/asefile.mjs: Reads and writes .aseprite files in plain Node (layers or a single layer, linked cels, tags, palette); export.mjs, seed.mjs and the painters use it when Aseprite isn't installed
tools/aseprite/export.mjs: Exports aseprite/**/*.aseprite with aseprite -b to assets/sprites/<key>.png + .json, checks tags/size against the code sprite, rewrites the manifest
tools/aseprite/lib.mjs: Aseprite tool helpers: find the Aseprite executable, read a creature sprite headless, write PNGs; readPng and tryAseprite for the Node fallback
tools/aseprite/paint/angel.mjs: Painter: detailed Guardian Angel 44×44 from the game's Avatar body plus feathered wings, halo glow and holy light
tools/aseprite/paint/beast.mjs: Painter: detailed four-legged familiars 40×28 (War Hound, Spirit Fox), idle/walk/run/attack/skill × 3 directions
tools/aseprite/paint/bird.mjs: Painter: detailed birds 36×28, side view (Archer's falcon, Arcane Owl): fly, dive, taunt
tools/aseprite/paint/boss.mjs: Painter: Dark Continent bosses Dolora 64×72, Morgrave 96×104, Vorgath 112×112, idle/walk/run/attack/skill × 3 directions
tools/aseprite/paint/economy.mjs: Paint editable Aseprite coin denominations, consumable icons and wallet/slot frames; export via ui keys
tools/aseprite/paint/fx.mjs: Painter: skill and hit effects (meteor, blast, lightning, holy, sphere, slash, wave, bolt, arrow, arrowfall, bite, claw, arcane, tear, bonespike, chain, shockring); grey ones are tinted in game
tools/aseprite/paint/guild.mjs: Paints the guild hall (aseprite/ui/guild_hall.aseprite) in the tile style with the scenery kit; the staff, plate, caravan and resource art are hand-finished sources (restyled by restyle.mjs)
tools/aseprite/paint/kit.mjs: Painting kit for the procedural Aseprite starting points: Canvas (lit dithered blobs, thick lines, polygons, outline, sparks), fromGame, build() → aseprite/<key>.aseprite via seed.lua
tools/aseprite/paint/monsterkit.mjs: Shared kit for the monster family painters: frame counts/durations, tile ramps, motion curves per animation, body/taper/curve shapes, overlay contours, skill FX and finish() (tile-style outline + grain); the look system: five views (upright turn / low tilt for the three-quarter views), eyeCol() faces (blink, angry), eightWay() wrapper and turnFinished()
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters.mjs: Paints every monster and code-drawn boss as aseprite/<monster|boss>/<key>.aseprite with its family painter (Avatars and one-offs seeded from tile-style code frames): node tools/aseprite/paint/monsters.mjs [keys…] [--family X] [--preview]
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters/brute.mjs: Monster painter: BruteSprite family (ogres, golems, yetis, trolls, demons), fur or stone, horns, wings, weapons; 52×56
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters/crab.mjs: Monster painter: CrabSprite family (crabs, scarabs, spiders, krakens); 36×26
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters/drake.mjs: Monster painter: DrakeSprite family (drakes, gargoyles, birds), bat or feathered wings, flyers and walkers; 44×36
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters/imp.mjs: Monster painter: ImpSprite family (imps, bats, crows, moths, hornets); 30×30
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters/serpent.mj: Monster painter: SerpentSprite family (serpents, nagas, leeches, hydras); 44×30
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters/slime.mjs: Monster painter: SlimeSprite family through slime.mjs with each monster's colours as tile ramps; 32×24
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters/specter.mj: Monster painter: SpecterSprite family (specters, wraiths, banshees, shackled souls, the sorrow wisp); 30×36
tools/aseprite/paint/monsters/wolf.mjs: Monster painter: WolfSprite family through beast.mjs with each monster's fur as tile ramps; 40×28
tools/aseprite/paint/paint.mjs: Recreates the detailed procedural .aseprite starting points (overwrites): node tools/aseprite/paint/paint.mjs <key|all>
tools/aseprite/paint/restyle.mjs: Gives hand-made single-frame .aseprite art the tile style in place (lifts the flat ink, grades colours, hue-shifted outline): node tools/aseprite/paint/restyle.mjs ui/guild_plate …
tools/aseprite/paint/scenery.mjs: Scenery kit for the safe-zone painters: alpha Img canvas, flagstones, clearings, shingles, timber walls, tents, braziers, banners, crates, barrels, smoke, campfire
tools/aseprite/paint/slime.mjs: Painter: detailed slime 32×24 (Forest Slime; Pocket Slime with sprout), idle/walk/run/attack/skill × 3 directions
tools/aseprite/paint/tiles.mjs: Painter for the terrain tile sets → aseprite/tiles/<theme>.aseprite (15 themes; layers liquid, foam, ground, path, decor; 8 frames): corner tiles with rounded/inner corners, cliff faces, foam, liquids (water, lava, void, ice, blood, murk), decorations
tools/aseprite/paint/ui.mjs: Painter for the HD interface frames (2× pixel density): hero card, party slots, portrait, meters, key chips, side-menu panels and buttons → aseprite/ui/<key>.aseprite
tools/aseprite/paint/zones.mjs: Paints the safe zones as layered .aseprite files in the tile sets' style: themed Fated Vanguard camps per map (clearings in the map's tile-set path soil), Barracks + longhouses, Imperial Citadel + dais, Emberhold; colours graded and outlined like the tiles
tools/aseprite/seed.mjs: Starts aseprite/<kind>/<key>.aseprite from a creature's code-drawn frames (one tag per direction+animation): node tools/aseprite/seed.mjs monster/slime
tools/audio/render-audio.mjs: Offline renders of the music, jingles and SFX to WAV/MP3 with peak/RMS checks: node tools/audio/render-audio.mjs [music|jingles|sfx|<name>…] [--mp3] [--out dir]; exits 1 on clipping or silence
tools/cinema/preview.mjs:
Renders HD cinematic frames headless with the game's code: node tools/cinema/preview.mjs pro:@

| act:@ [--sheet] [--w 1920]
tools/mcp/playwright-mcp.mjs: Launches the pinned @playwright/mcp server with the session's Chromium (no sandbox as root) and serves the repo on 127.0.0.1:5173
tools/mcp/vof-game-mcp.mjs: vof-game MCP server (stdio, no deps): game_start/input/hold/state/screenshot/eval/travel/autoplay/logs/stop on the real game in headless Chromium
tools/tilemap/lineup.mjs: Line-up PNG of sprites standing on a tile set (plain Node): node tools/tilemap/lineup.mjs <theme> monster:<k> merc:<k> summon:<k> npc:<id> act:<map> zone:<k> ui:<k> [--scale n] [--anim a] [--code] [--out file]
tools/tilemap/preview.mjs: Renders every terrain tile set on its layout (480×270 views + contact sheet) and the maps in data/tilemaps.json to PNG in headless Chromium: node tools/tilemap/preview.mjs [themes…] [--layout k] [--seed n] [--scale n] [--out dir]
tools/tilemap/viewer.html: Page used by tools/tilemap/preview.mjs to render terrain tile sets and maps
